# The Reach Smart

> The Reach Smart is an AI automation agency that builds custom, autonomous AI systems for SaaS companies and E-commerce brands. Rather than selling software subscriptions or off-the-shelf chatbots, Reach Smart designs, builds, and maintains bespoke operational workflows integrated directly into existing tech stacks.

## Core Capabilities

- **AI Customer Support Systems**: Autonomous 24/7 support agents for SaaS & e-commerce. Resolves up to 60% of tier-1 inquiries (order status, returns, technical FAQs) in under 30 seconds, integrated with Shopify, WooCommerce, Gorgias, and Zendesk.
- **Lead Finder & Enrichment System**: Automated B2B lead discovery identifying target accounts and key decision-makers based on ideal customer profiles (ICP), hiring signals, and tech stacks.
- **Personalized Cold Outreach Engine**: Contextualized cold email and LinkedIn outreach sequences tailored to each prospect's business context, operating autonomously until interest is shown.
- **UGC Content Engine**: Automated script generation, ad creative variations, hooks, and messaging variations for e-commerce performance marketing.
- **Post-Purchase Communication Automation**: Post-purchase customer onboarding, automated review acquisition, repeat purchase reminders, and retention flows.

## Verified Industry Benchmarks

- **Support Inquiries**: Up to 60% automated resolution rate; response times reduced from 6 hours to <30 seconds.
- **Sales Efficiency**: 2.5 hours per sales representative saved daily on lead research; 350–500 qualified B2B leads generated monthly.
- **Outreach Performance**: ~2,000 hyper-personalized outreach emails per month with 40% open rates and 8% response rates, generating 20–35 qualified sales meetings monthly.

## Technology Stack & Integrations

- **E-Commerce**: Shopify, WooCommerce, Klaviyo
- **CRM & Helpdesk**: Gorgias, Zendesk, HubSpot, Salesforce
- **AI Models & Frameworks**: OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude 3.5), Custom RAG pipelines
- **Automation Backends**: Make.com, n8n, Custom Node.js & Cloudflare Edge APIs
